lead.objective: Apply the Agy-Squad PR Review Standard v1.3.0 (.agents/skills/pr-review/SKILL.md) to audit .agents/skills/self-diagnosis and .agents/skills/pr-review for contract accuracy, progressive disclosure, and token efficiency.
lead.instructions: For subagent fallback, compile via 'diagnose.mjs --print-dispatch skill_and_pr_review_audit --parent-id <id>'. On /swarm, wait via swarm_wait for READY receipts, inspect specialist reports with rtk read, write verified synthesis ('Content Verdict: PASS', FAIL, or BLOCKED) preserving 1-ID-per-finding granularity (never compress or omit distinct P0-P3/optimization/residual items before prune), verify planner-assigned flat audit-* reports 'Integrity Verdict: CLEAN', run 'node bin/agy-squad.mjs' (fingerprint, inspect, bundle, verify, prune), and post <=500B READY.
lead.expectedDeliverable: Synthesis report with Content Verdict: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED, SKILL/DOC/ARCH/SCRIPT triage, and verified SHA-256 hashes.

specialists.objective: Audit .agents/skills/self-diagnosis/SKILL.md, scripts/diagnose.mjs, resources/self-diagnosis-manifest.json, and references/optimization-and-review-rubric.md using pr-review SKILL/DOC/SCRIPT criteria: verify frontmatter, relative links, CLI flags, progressive disclosure ratio (SKILL.md vs references/), and propose concrete token or runtime optimizations.
specialists.instructions: Use rtk read via run_command to inspect your scopeFiles (never call read_file; pass --allow-active-cohort when running diagnose.mjs while sibling cohorts are active, and never run --teardown mid-cohort).
specialists.expectedDeliverable: Markdown evidence report with SKILL/DOC/SCRIPT P1/P2/P3 triage, progressive disclosure byte counts, concrete optimization proposals, and exact line references.
